draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling decodes faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
rationale: T1.r1.lat=41 and T1.r2.lat=118 directly support a latency difference. The hedge "may" understates the reported values, which are stated as measured medians. However, note the latencies were measured on different accelerators (A2 fp16 vs A1 fp32), so the comparison is not directly controlled; still the claim as stated is supported and can be stated unhedged within the reported scope.
